sloka: स मण्डलीकृतधनू रावणिः समितिञ्जयः।हरीनभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धः परं लाघवमास्थितः ।। ६.९१.१५ ।।
transliteration: sa maṇḍalīkṛtadhanū rāvaṇiḥ samitiñjayaḥ।harīnabhyahanat kruddhaḥ paraṁ lāghavamāsthitaḥ ।। 6.91.15 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, a winner of combat, became highly furious and stretched his bow showing his skill easily struck at Vanaras.
